leadText:
Electric Pikachu Boogaloo issue 4 is the twelfth monthly issue of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the thirteenth and fourteenth chapters of the manga, as well as some bonus content that was not in the original volume. 

The contents of this issue were later rereleased by VIZ Media as part of .
